name: SearchTheTrend
description:
SearchTheTrend tracks brands and ads on Meta so you can research competitors by just asking.

Ask about any brand and get their active ads, estimated spend, media mix, top angles and landing pages. Not tracking them yet? Paste their Facebook Ad Library link and request a live scan.

Go deeper on any ad: real age and gender breakdown of who it actually reached (not who the brand claims to target), its rank among all the advertiser's ads, days running, and estimated spend. Every creative comes classified by hook, angle, offer type and awareness stage, so you can understand why an ad works instead of just copying it.

You can also search winning products, see which pages advertise them and through which funnels, track niches before they saturate, and pull up trending products by ad growth.

Built for dropshippers, DTC brands and media buyers who want digested strategy instead of raw data. Example questions:

"My competitor is brand.com. What are they doing on Meta right now and what should I copy?"
"Who is their best ad actually reaching? Break down age and gender."
"What's the hook, angle and awareness stage of their winning ad?"
"Find me products blowing up in the fitness niche that aren't saturated yet."

_published_faq.name: How do I add SearchTheTrend to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add SearchTheTrend to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://www.searchthetrend.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the SearchTheTrend MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: SearchTheTrend lists 22 MCP tools, including fetch, get_ad, get_ad_reach_history, get_advertiser, get_brand, get_brand_creative_mix, get_brand_history, get_brand_scan_status, get_domain_intel, get_product, get_product_history, and get_product_sources.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to SearchTheTrend?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to SearchTheTrend in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
SearchTheTrend requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
SearchTheTrend is developed by SearchTheTrend. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
